 ERROR  SENNIT_PHRASE is set, and --phrase-stdin was given too
  That is two recovery phrases, and taking either would be a
  guess about which one was meant.

 HINT   remove SENNIT_PHRASE from the environment to read the
        phrase from stdin
 HINT   or leave out `--phrase-stdin` to use SENNIT_PHRASE

 ERROR  --phrase-stdin was given, and no phrase arrived on stdin
  With the flag the phrase is read from the first line of stdin
  and from nowhere else. That line was empty, or stdin is a
  terminal rather than a pipe or a file.

 HINT   pipe the phrase in, or redirect a file that holds it
 HINT   or leave out `--phrase-stdin` to use SENNIT_PHRASE, the
        stored profile or the prompt
